blur(6px);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(13,82,87,0.06)} .header-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto auto;align-items:center;gap:16px;padding:14px 0} .brand{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.5rem;color:var(--teal-ink);text-decoration:none;font-weight:700} .btn:hover,.btn:focus{transform:translateY(-1px);box-shadow:var(--shadow)} .btn:active{transform:translateY(0)} .btn-primary{--_bg:var(--teal);--_fg:#fff;--_bd:transparent} .feature-icon{width:38px;height:38px;display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:12px;background:var(--sand);margin-bottom:10px;font-size:1.15rem} /* Cards / Programs */ .faq-toggle::after{content:'+';font-weight:900;color:var(--teal-ink)} .faq-item[open] .faq-toggle::after,.faq-toggle[aria-expanded="true"]::after{content:'–'} .faq-panel{padding:0 0 .lead-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;gap:20px;align-items:center} .inline-form{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:flex-start} .inline-form input[type="email"]{flex:1;min-width:240px;border:1px solid rgba(13,82,87,.2);border-radius:14px;padding:.7rem .8rem;background:var(--off);color:var(--ink)} .inline-form .hint{margin:.25rem 0 0;height:140px;background:url('../img/pattern.svg') center/auto 200px repeat;opacity:.3} /* CTA */ .cta{background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(13,82,87,.06), rgba(13,82,87,0));text-align:center} /* Footer */ .site-footer{padding:36px 0 22px;background:linear-gradient(180deg, #fff, var(--off))} .footer-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.2fr 1fr 1fr;gap:24px;align-items:start} .footer-nav{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:grid;gap:6px} .footer-nav a{color:var(--ink);text-decoration:none} .footer-nav a:hover,.footer-nav a:focus{text-decoration:underline} .link{color:var(--teal-ink)} .legal{border-top:1px solid rgba(13,82,87,.12);margin-top:20px;padding-top:16px;color:var(--muted)} /* Utilities */ .section-header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;gap:20px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:12px} .cards .btn{margin-top:6px} /* Responsive */ @media (max-width: 980px){ .hero-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr} .hero-visual{order:-1} .grid-4{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)} .cards{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr} .grid-3{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr} .footer-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr} } @media (max-width: 720px){ .header-grid{grid-template-columns:auto auto 1fr} .site-nav{position:fixed;inset:64px 0 auto 0;background:#fff;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(13,82,87,.12);transform:translateY(-120%);transition:transform .25s ease;box-shadow:0 12px 24px rgba(13,82,87,.12);padding:14px 0} .site-nav ul{flex-direction:column;gap:0} .site-nav a{padding:12px 16px;border-radius:0} .site-nav .nav-cta{margin:8px 16px 4px} .site-nav[data-open="true"]{transform:translateY(0)}
